message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a white background with a large black "TEMPO" logo at the top. Below the logo, a central figure is draped in a textured, dark black garment resembling a niqab, forming a large triangular silhouette. The person’s face is concealed, except for a triangular opening in the fabric. Within this opening, instead of facial features, there is a glowing orange-red texture featuring a rectangular digital timer display showing the digits "00:00".

Large red text overlays the lower torso of the figure, reading "AMALIYAH DI JALAN YANG SALAH". Below this, smaller white text in Indonesian describes a police action involving a female subject. Further text at the very top of the page includes "INVESTIGASI: OBRAL IZIN FAKULTAS KEDOKTERAN" and "TAKSI EXPRESS DI UJUNG TANDUK". A red vertical stripe borders the left edge. A small colorful logo with "45" and "1971-2016" is in the upper left. At the bottom right, there is a date of "19-25 DESEMBER 2016," a price of "RP 45.000," and a barcode. The overall image has a grainy, stippled texture.
